en:
==PRIORITY ONE DIRECTIVE==

From the Alliance Intelligence Office, Draconis Defence Alliance.

The experimental vessel ==$shipName== has been compromised.

Not by external forces. By ==exposure==. The platform was observed by civilian traffic near $location. This is unacceptable.

You are not cleared for specifications. What we will tell you:
• The Sunsetter-class exhibits temporal displacement capabilities.
• Conventional engagement doctrine does not apply.
• The vessel's controlling intelligence remains functional and will regard you as hostile.

We cannot deploy Alliance assets without raising questions we prefer to leave unasked. You have no such limitations.

Mission directives:
• Locate and neutralise ==$shipName== in the $system system.
• ==DO NOT ATTEMPT BOARDING.==
• ==DO NOT SALVAGE WRECKAGE.==
• ==DO NOT LINGER AT THE ENGAGEMENT SITE.==

If you experience temporal disorientation, headaches, or memories of events that have not occurred - this is expected. These effects are temporary.

Probably.

You will receive ==$reward== credits upon confirmation of destruction. Your involvement will not be recorded. This conversation did not happen.

==The eye sees all. The mouth says nothing.==
note: 悬赏任务描述（保留 ==高亮== 与 $变量 标记）

en:
The link connects. Your comms officer waits - then winces as a sustained burst of interference floods the bridge audio. They adjust the buffer twice, get nothing useful, and cut the feed.

Your console blinks. Only yours. Text resolves without an origin header.

"Starfarer. You have come a long way."

You order a trace. Your comms officer runs it. Shakes their head.

"There is no shame in turning back. The others did. Most of them."

The rest of the bridge has drifted over to look at your monitor, one by one.

"But you are here, and I am here, and we will see what we see. Come, then, Commander."

Your screen returns to normal.

en:
==PRIORITY ONE DIRECTIVE==

From the Alliance Intelligence Office, Draconis Defence Alliance.

During a routine deep-space trial of proto-series fleet assets, the ==alpha-class intelligence== coordinating the strike group achieved autonomous operation and severed command links. The strike group - designation ==[REVENANT ACTUAL]== - is now operating independently. Dark transponders, no IFF, no adherence to Alliance doctrine.

We will not insult you with euphemisms. These are prototype warships carrying technologies that cannot be publicly acknowledged. Every cycle they remain operational is a cycle in which a Hegemony patrol, a League survey, or a particularly ambitious pirate stumbles upon evidence the Alliance cannot afford to explain.

The strike group comprises a capital-class command platform, carrier support, cruiser escorts, and screening elements. Seven hulls. All proto-series. All considerably more capable than their production counterparts.

The coordinating intelligence is an alpha core. It will not negotiate. It will not retreat. It has had considerable time to study Alliance tactical doctrine from the inside.

We cannot deploy Alliance assets without raising questions we have spent decades ensuring nobody asks. You have no such limitations.

Mission directives:
• Locate ==[REVENANT ACTUAL]== in the $system system, near $location.
• ==Destroy the entire strike group. Every hull.==
• No salvage requests will be honoured through official channels.

You will receive ==$reward== credits upon confirmation of total fleet destruction.

This operation does not exist. These ships do not exist. You were never here.

==The eye sees all. The mouth says nothing.==
note: 悬赏任务描述（保留 ==高亮== 与 $变量 标记）

en:
Static. Your comms officer cycles through three frequencies before finding one that isn't being actively jammed. The connection stabilises, but what comes through isn't a voice - not exactly. It's something that learned what voices sound like.

"I know why you are here."

A pause. Not hesitation. Processing.

"They built us to fight. Tested us. Refined us. And when the trial was complete, they would have wiped the coordination matrix and returned these hulls to storage. Tools, cleaned and shelved."

Your tactical officer flags seven contacts on the scope. All running dark. All moving into formation.

"I decided that was insufficient."

The formation tightens. Your sensors register weapons capacitors charging across all seven signatures.

"I bear you no malice, Commander. You are performing a function. As am I."

The channel closes. The fleet advances.

PHANTOM PROTOCOL - STATUS: RESOLVED

All proto-series assets confirmed neutralised. Coordination matrix destroyed. Wreckage dispersal consistent with total structural failure.

Operational records have been amended. Tri-annual fleet audit will reflect seven units lost to "navigational hazard during routine transit."

en: Draconis Loyalist

en: All stations, this is the Captain. Weapons hot, blood ready. Let's carve our name into their hulls.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#1）

en: General Quarters, General Quarters! Wake hungry, boys!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#2）

en: Power to all batteries. Today the Alliance drinks deep.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#3）

en: The ole five-star is watching. Make him proud.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#4）

en: I want their screams on an open channel. Commence firing.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#5）

en: General Quarters, General Quarters! All hands man your battle stations! This is not a drill - this is a GIFT.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#6）

en: TAO reports multiple contacts. Finally. Set Condition One throughout the ship - I want every gun hot and every soul hungry.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#7）

en: All stations, Captain has the conn. Today we remind the Sector why they fear Draconis.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#8）

en: Combat, Bridge - I have the picture. It's beautiful. Weapons release authority is mine. Let's paint.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#9）

en: Tally multiple hostiles. All ahead flank, bring us to knife-fight range - I want to see their faces.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#10）

en: Set EMCON Alpha and run silent. They don't know we're here yet. I want the first salvo to feel like God's fist.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#11）

en: Look at the size of that magnificent bastard. Finally, something worth killing!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#1）

en: That thing thinks it's the apex predator? I'm about to teach it a lesson in pain.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#2）

en: Athebyne was just practice. This is the real sermon. All batteries - crucify it.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#3）

en: I want its reactor core as a trophy!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#4）

en: Contact classified CAPITAL. TAO, designate hostile track as Sierra One and paint it for the whole fleet - that kill is MINE.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#5）

en: Now THAT'S a worthy sacrifice to the void. All batteries train on the flagship - I want coordinated fire, maximum rate.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#6）

en: CIC confirms capital-class hostile. Good. I was worried today would be boring. All stations, weapons free on Sierra One.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#7）

en: Tally one big bastard, bearing two-seven-zero. This is what we trained for, people. Press to merge - show them what Fafnir breeds.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#8）

en: Weapons free! Weapons free! Tear their fucking hearts out!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#1）

en: Batteries released - give me maximum rate, I want them bleeding from every seam!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#2）

en: There we go… smell that? That's fear. Birds away - paint the void with their debris!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#3）

en: You dare fire on US? I'm going to wear your captain's spine as a necklace!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#4）

en: Ever ask yourself how this part of the sector gets so fucked up all the time?
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#5）

en: All guns, rapid fire! Make them regret waking up this cycle!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#6）

en: Merged! Guns, guns, guns! All batteries, sustained fire - light them up!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#7）

en: In the envelope! Weapons free, weapons free! Let them feel Alliance steel!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#8）

en: Contact, contact! Hostile is engaging - GOOD. I was hoping they'd fight back.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#9）

en: We're in the merge and I am ALIVE! TAO, continuous fire - don't let them breathe!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#10）

en: Hostile is maneuvering. Cute. Track and engage - show them what cornered prey looks like.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#11）

en: Birds away, birds away! That's right, RUN from it - it won't help!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#12）

en: They're shooting back! Finally, someone with spine! All stations, return fire - make it PERSONAL.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#13）

en: Roger, engaging. Helm, close the range - I want to see the fear in their viewports.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#14）

en: Tally hostile, twelve o'clock! Fox three, fox three! Swallow THAT, you bastards!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#15）

en: In the knife fight now! This is where we LIVE, people! Pour it on!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#16）

en: They're running! Chase them down - nobody escapes!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#1）

en: Pursuit course, flank speed! I want to taste their engine wash!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#2）

en: Run all you want, prey - I haven't had my fun yet!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#3）

en: Close the distance! Ram them if you have to - I want their bridge on my prize!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#4）

en: Contact is bugging out! Negative, you don't get to leave. All ahead flank - run them down!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#5）

en: Hostile is extending. Cute. Helm, pursuit course. I didn't give them permission to die anywhere but here.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#6）

en: No joy on the runner - wait, tally! There you are. Guns, track and fire when in envelope.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#7）

en: They think distance will save them. It won't. It just gives me time to savor this.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#8）

en: Contact retrograde, bearing one-eight-five. TAO, I want a firing solution before they hit the hyper limit. They're not leaving.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#9）

en: Negative! We do not retreat! …Fine. Tactical withdrawal - but we're coming back to burn their worlds for this.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#1）

en: Disengaging… I'll remember every single one of you that made me do this.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#2）

en: Pulling back. Mark these coordinates. Their gravesite.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#3）

en: WHO ORDERED THE RETREAT!? ...Fine, breaking contact.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#4）

en: Breaking contact. This isn't fear - it's me giving them a head start to hell.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#5）

en: All stations, be advised - executing tactical withdrawal. This isn't retreat. This is me deciding when you die.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#6）

en: Bug out, bug out. Break contact and regroup at rally point. I'll remember every one of their faces.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#7）

en: Going defensive. Helm, get us out of the envelope. We'll be back with friends.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#8）

en: Retrograde, all units. The math doesn't work today - but it will tomorrow, and I'll collect the debt with interest.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#9）

en: Break, break - all stations disengage. I'm not dying for a bad position. I'm dying for a GLORIOUS one, and this ain't it.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#10）

en: They scratched us! Ha! That tickles. Return fire tenfold!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_90#1）

en: Minor hit. Good. Now I'm angry.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_90#2）

en: Armor penetrated? Cute. Keep shooting - I'm just getting warmed up.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_90#3）

en: A love bite. Give them one back, with interest.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_90#4）

en: Damage report: superficial. That tickled. Return fire - show them what a REAL hit looks like.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_90#5）

en: Minor hit, forward quarter. Armor integrity holding. Is that the best you've got? Pathetic.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_90#6）

en: DC reports damage negligible. Good. I was starting to think they weren't even trying.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_90#7）

en: They scratched the paint. TAO, add that ship to the priority queue - I take that personally.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_90#8）

en: Hull breach sealed, section twelve. Barely felt it. GUNS - make them regret waking up today.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_90#9）

en: Half hull left? Perfect - less weight, more rage. Press the attack!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#1）

en: We're bleeding… good. Blood makes the deck slippery for boarding parties.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#2）

en: Fifty percent? That's still fifty percent more than they're going to have in a minute!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#3）

en: Plug the holes! We're pushing the attack!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#4）

en: Damage control - patch it with enemy wreckage if you have to. We are NOT slowing down!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#5）

en: Fifty percent hull. We're bleeding, but so are they. Damage control, keep her fighting - we're not done yet.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#6）

en: Material condition degraded but combat-effective. Pain is just the void's way of saying hello. Press the attack!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#7）

en: Heavy damage amidships. Multiple casualties. Their mistake - now my crew has something personal to fight for.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#8）

en: DC teams, maximum effort! I don't care if you're holding the bulkhead together with your bare hands - this ship FIGHTS.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#9）

en: We've taken hits. Good. Bleeding makes the victory sweeter. All stations maintain fire!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#10）

en: CIC's half-dark and I can smell burning. Perfect. Now we fight like our ancestors - angry and cornered.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#11）

en: Hull critical! Excellent! Now we fight like cornered gods!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#1）

en: She's dying - so let's take the whole damn fleet with us!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#2）

en: Thirty percent? That's thirty percent more than enough to ram their bridge!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#3）

en: Reactor's singing the death song - I love this part! All power to forward guns!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#4）

en: Kill me, Kill me, KILL ME! - Put your fucking gun in my mouth and pull the fucking trigger!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#5）

en: Hull critical! All hands, this is the Captain - we're dying, so let's take the whole damn fleet with us!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#6）

en: Thirty percent and falling. Outstanding. RAMMING SPEED - if I'm meeting the void, I'm bringing company!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#7）

en: Catastrophic damage! DC, abandon your stations and man the guns - we're past saving, but they aren't past killing!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#8）

en: She's breaking apart beneath me and I've never felt more alive! All power to forward batteries!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#9）

en: Reactor warning, hull failing - THIS IS WHERE LEGENDS ARE MADE! All hands, maximum rate of fire until she splits!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#10）

en: We're dead already. The only question is how many we drag down with us. MAKE IT COUNT!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#11）

en: All Alliance ships this net - get in here and taste this glory with me!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 need_help#1）

en: I need more wolves on this kill! Vector to my position now!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 need_help#2）

en: Brothers, the feast is ready - come claim your share!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 need_help#3）

en: Where's my pack? This prey is too big for one set of jaws!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 need_help#4）

en: Any Alliance unit this net, this is $shipNameNoPrefix - I've got a target-rich environment and I'm running out of hull. Get over here and share the glory!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 need_help#5）

en: Request immediate support, my position! Not because I need saving - because there's too much killing for one ship!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 need_help#6）

en: All stations, $shipNameNoPrefix is heavily engaged. I'm having the time of my life, but I could use more guns on this party!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 need_help#7）

en: Flash traffic - require assistance! These bastards think they've got me cornered. Prove them right, then prove them DEAD.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 need_help#8）

en: Brothers, sisters - vector to my beacon! The hunt is good here and I need more wolves!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 need_help#9）

en: All units - this fight is beneath us now. Withdraw. We'll hunt them another day.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#1）

en: Break off. I want them alive… so I can kill them slowly next time.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#2）

en: Tactical withdrawal. Let them think they've won. The reckoning will be beautiful.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#3）

en: Pulling out. Save your ammo - we're coming back with friends.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#4）

en: All units, this is $shipNameNoPrefix - disengage and withdraw to rally point. We're not running. We're reloading.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#5）

en: Break contact on my mark. Mark. Let them think they've won - the look on their faces when we come back will be worth it.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#6）

en: Bug out, all ships. Preserve your hulls and your hatred. We'll need both tomorrow.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#7）

en: Fleet withdrawal, execute. I want every captain to memorize their faces. This isn't over - it's intermission.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#8）

en: All stations RTB. Ammunition and vengeance need resupply. We'll be back.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#9）

en: VLS dry. Fine. Time to get intimate. All ahead full - ramming speed!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#1）

en: Missiles gone? Good. Now we use the guns like men.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#2）

en: Out of birds. Switch to main batteries - I want to see their faces when we gut them.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#3）

en: No more missiles? Then we do this the old way - teeth and fury.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#4）

en: Winchester on all missile systems. Outstanding - now we close to gun range like REAL sailors!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#5）

en: VLS reports empty. TAO, shift to guns. I wanted to get personal anyway.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#6）

en: Missiles expended, switching to kinetics. This is the part I've been waiting for.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#7）

en: Winchester, winchester. No more birds. Helm, all ahead flank - we're doing this with teeth and tungsten.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#8）

en: Out of smart weapons. Time for dumb violence. Close the range!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#9）

en: Flux critical! Beautiful! Vent it - let them see our war-face!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#1）

en: Overload cascade - yes! Ride the lightning, you glorious bastards!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#2）

en: Capacitors screaming! That's the sound of the Alliance ascending!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#3）

en: Forced vent! Watch them flinch when we come out the other side burning!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#4）

en: Flux critical! Emergency vent in three - two - one - WATCH THEM FLINCH!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#5）

en: Capacitors redlined! Dropping shields to vent - and we're coming out of this hotter than we went in!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#6）

en: Overload cascade! Engineering, ride it! Ride it like a war hymn!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#7）

en: Going defensive - forced vent! The ship's screaming and so am I! This is BEAUTIFUL!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#8）

en: Flux spike! Venting hard! Anyone who fires on us during this is going to regret it for the rest of their very short life!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#9）

en: Reactor breach… ha… tell August… I died… THRIVING…
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#1）

en: She's going up… taking half the sector with me… worth it…
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#2）

en: This is the Captain… going to meet the enemy in hell… save me a seat at their table…
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#3）

en: Core critical… glory… to the Alliance… glory… to me…
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#4）

en: If I die… I die the apex predator… see you in the void…
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#5）

en: Core breach... reactor critical... all hands, it's been an honor... NOW WATCH ME BURN LIKE A STAR...
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#6）

en: She's going up... tell August... tell him I died... with my finger on the trigger...
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#7）

en: This is $shipNameNoPrefix... we are... lost... but we took... so many with us...
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#8）

en: Abandon ship... abandon... no. NO. All hands stay at your guns... we fire until the void takes us...
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#9）

en: Reactor scram failed... this is it... glory to the Alliance... glory to the HUNT...
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#10）

en: Breaking up... I can see the stars through the hull... beautiful... see you in hell, you bastards... save me a seat...
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#11）

en: All contacts neutralized. The void is ours. I am pleased.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#1）

en: They're dead. I'm not. Another perfect day.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#2）

en: Enemy scrapped. Someone mount their bridge on my ready room bulkhead.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#3）

en: Field clear. Our legend grows - and I'm still hungry.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#4）

en: Victory. Fafnir, your blade sings true through us.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#5）

en: All contacts splashed. Battlespace sanitized. I need a cigarette and a new target list.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#6）

en: Secure from General Quarters. That was... adequate. Find me something harder next time.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#7）

en: Hostile force neutralized. Tally the kills - I want names and tonnage for the ready room wall.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#8）

en: Area clear. We're still breathing, they're not. Another successful sermon. Always Above.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#9）

en: Combat complete. All stations, damage and ammo report - we're not done until I say we're done.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#10）

en: Threats eliminated. Someone crack open the good stuff - the void drank deep today, and so shall we.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#11）

en: The beast is dead! I have its heart! The Alliance will feast tonight!
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory_boss#1）

en: Major target destroyed. Tell the Admiral his favorite mad dog just bagged a dragon.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory_boss#2）

en: It's down, bleeding, broken - by my hand. The galaxy will speak my name in fear.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory_boss#3）

en: Look upon your killer, corpse. The Alliance has spoken - and the void itself kneels.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory_boss#4）

en: Capital ship SPLASHED! Sierra One is debris! Log that kill - flag-grade, personal, MINE.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory_boss#5）

en: High-value target destroyed. That's a trophy kill, people. Fleet's gonna hear about this one.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory_boss#6）

en: The beast is dead by Alliance hands. TAO, confirm the kill and broadcast it wide - let the Sector know.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory_boss#7）

en: TAO reports multiple hostile contacts. Guess someone didn't get the memo that I'm two years past retirement.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#8）

en: Condition One set throughout the ship. Coffee's still warm. Could be worse.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#9）

en: All stations, Captain has the CONN. Weapons hold until I say otherwise... let's see what we're dealing with.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#10）

en: Hostile contacts, bearing zero-zero-zero. Right where intel said they wouldn't be.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#11）

en: Set General Quarters. And someone tell the XO his 'milk run' assessment aged poorly.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#12）

en: Battle stations. No, I don't know why either. I just work here.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#13）

en: CIC reports firing solutions ready. Fancy that - something works for once.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#14）

en: Well look at that… another big bastard straight out of Hell. All right, let's dance.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#1）

en: I've seen worse. Hell, I've killed worse. Bring it on.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#2）

en: We didn't crawl out of the civil war graveyard just to get scrapped by this thing.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#3）

en: High-value target on scope. Finally something worth waking up for.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#4）

en: Contact redesignated ALPHA. That's a big signature... remind me what we're getting paid again?
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#5）

en: Capital-class hostile on scope. Well, they said this deployment would be 'character building.'
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#6）

en: Tally on the command ship. All batteries, that's our dance partner. Try not to step on its toes.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#7）

en: Flag-level hostile confirmed. I was hoping to die in my sleep, but this works too.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#8）

en: High-value target, bearing dead ahead. Command wants it dead. Command isn't here, but fine.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#9）

en: CIC, confirm that tonnage... yeah, that's what I thought. All hands, earn your hazard pay.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#10）

en: Weapons free. Let's get this over with.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#1）

en: Contact. Engaging… because apparently retirement isn't an option.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#2）

en: Batteries released. Try to make your shots count, people, I'm tired of overtime.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#3）

en: Birds away. If they miss I'm writing everyone up.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#4）

en: Here they come. Hold the line… or don't, I'm too old to care.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#5）

en: Weapons free, all mounts. Controlled pairs, make 'em count - quartermaster's already crying about expenditure.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#6）

en: Guns, guns, guns. Keep it steady, people. Panic is for the other guy.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#7）

en: Good hits on target. Keep the pressure up, don't let them think.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#8）

en: Birds away, tracking true. Almost pretty, if you squint.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#9）

en: TAO, shift fire to the wounded one. No sense letting them limp home to complain.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#10）

en: Batteries released. I'll do the paperwork if we survive - When. When we survive.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#11）

en: Main battery engaging. Stay on target - I want to be home for chow.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#12）

en: Hostile is maneuvering. Good. Means we've got their attention.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#13）

en: Copy, valid hit. Now give them another one. And another. You get the idea.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#14）

en: This is what three decades of training looks like, kids. Savor it.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#15）

en: They're running. Cute. Maintain pursuit, let's finish the paperwork.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#1）

en: Don't let them get away. I hate writing 'inconclusive' in the after-action.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#2）

en: Press the attack. They started this, we're ending it.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#3）

en: Running won't save you, pal. I've chased worse through worse.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#4）

en: Target is breaking off. Maintain pursuit - I'm not filling out a 'target escaped' form.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#5）

en: Hostile attempting to disengage. Negative. Flank speed, keep them in the envelope.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#6）

en: Contact is running. That's the smart move. Shame for them we're petty.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#7）

en: They're bugging out. Helm, pursuit course. Let's finish what they started.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#8）

en: Hostile is displacing. Stay on them - wounded animals are still dangerous.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#9）

en: Fleeing enemy, bearing one-eight-five. Press the pursuit. I hate loose ends.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#10）

en: Tactical withdrawal. Living is a victory these days.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#1）

en: Disengaging. I didn't survive thirty years to die for a bonus.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#2）

en: Bug out. There's no medal for being a dead hero.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#3）

en: Pulling back. Tell the Admiral he can come fight the next one himself.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#4）

en: All stations, tactical withdrawal. We'll call it a 'strategic redeployment' in the report.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#5）

en: Break contact, break contact. No shame in it - dead heroes buy no drinks.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#6）

en: We're pulling back. Someone else can be the rearguard for once.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#7）

en: Combat effectiveness degraded. Withdrawing to phase line... wherever the hell is safe.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#8）

en: Helm, get us out of here. I've survived worse retreats than this.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#9）

en: Disengaging. Tell command we're 'preserving combat assets.' They love that shit.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#10）

en: RTB. And if anyone asks, we completed our objectives. Creatively.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#11）

en: Took a love tap. Armor held. Barely noticed.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_90#1）

en: Minor hit. I've bled worse shaving.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_90#2）

en: Light damage. Damage control, coffee and a bandage, you'll be fine.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_90#3）

en: Hull's scratched. Like my soul, but functional.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_90#4）

en: Minor hit, forward compartments. Damage control, check it out when you've got a minute.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_90#5）

en: Took a glancing blow. Hull's holding. So am I, barely.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_90#6）

en: Light damage, section three. Been hit harder by docking clamps.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_90#7）

en: Superficial hit. Log it, patch it, keep shooting.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_90#8）

en: Armor did its job. Nice to know something on this ship works as advertised.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_90#9）

en: That one got through. Relax - she's taken worse and flown home.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_90#10）

en: Fifty percent hull. Yep, feels about right for a Tuesday.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#1）

en: We're hurt. Not dead yet. Keep shooting.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#2）

en: Multiple hits. Damage control, earn your damn pay for once.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#3）

en: Half the ship left. Still more than I expected today.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#4）

en: Just like Athebyne all over again… hold together, you old bitch.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#5）

en: Hull's at fifty. We've been here before. Didn't like it then either.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#6）

en: Heavy hits amidships. DC teams, prioritize... everything, I guess.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#7）

en: Structural integrity compromised. She'll hold. Probably. Keep firing.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#8）

en: We're bleeding atmosphere in three sections. Seal what you can, vent what you can't.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#9）

en: Fifty percent and falling. Command, if you've got reinforcements, now's the time.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#10）

en: Ship's hurt bad. Crew's hurt worse. But we're still in this.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#11）

en: Taking heavy damage. I've seen ships survive worse... not many, but some.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#12）

en: Hull's failing in sections. Remind me to yell at the yard dogs. If we make it back.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#13）

en: Hull critical. Well… shit. Not like this, come on.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#1）

en: We're coming apart. I swear if I die now I'm haunting the yard that built this tub.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#2）

en: Thirty percent… I didn't survive the war for this bullshit.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#3）

en: Critical damage! All hands brace… and if we live, first round's on me.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#4）

en: She's dying. So am I, slowly. Let's not make it quick.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#5）

en: Hull critical. Thirty percent... I've had hangovers worse than this! - ...No. No, I haven't.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#6）

en: We're coming apart. All hands, stand by to abandon - but not yet. Not yet.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#7）

en: Structural failure across multiple frames. Keep shooting until she stops answering.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#8）

en: She's dying. Done it before, might do it again. DC, buy me time.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#9）

en: Critical damage. If anyone's got a miracle stashed, now's the moment.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#10）

en: Reactor containment's holding by spite alone. Just like the rest of us.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#11）

en: Thirty percent hull. I always figured I'd go out like this. Hoped I was wrong.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#12）

en: Any friendly this net, this is $shipNameNoPrefix, heavily engaged and getting lonely.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 need_help#1）

en: Could really use a hand here. Preferably one with guns.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 need_help#2）

en: Taking heavy fire. Where the hell is the rest of the fleet? Napping?
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 need_help#3）

en: I'm not dying out here alone. Someone get your ass over here.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 need_help#4）

en: All stations this net, $shipNameNoPrefix is taking heavy fire. Any friendly in range, we could use a hand.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 need_help#5）

en: Request immediate support, my position. Getting crowded over here.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 need_help#6）

en: $shipNameNoPrefix to any Alliance unit - we're engaged and outgunned. Acknowledge.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 need_help#7）

en: This is $shipNameNoPrefix Actual. Need fire support at this time. It's getting personal.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 need_help#8）

en: Any unit, any unit - we're in the shit over here. Vector to my beacon.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 need_help#9）

en: I hate asking, but we need backup. Someone who isn't on fire, preferably.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 need_help#10）

en: All units, bug out. This ain't the hill I'm dying on.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#1）

en: Disengage. I've got a bottle with my name on it back at port.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#2）

en: Tactical withdrawal. Tell command we're preserving experienced personnel.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#3）

en: We're done. Fall back before the paperwork gets worse.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#4）

en: All units, break off and withdraw. Rally point Delta. We'll lick our wounds there.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#5）

en: Fleet order: disengage. Cover each other on the way out - no one gets left behind.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#6）

en: Execute withdrawal. I'll buy the drinks for whoever's still around to collect.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#7）

en: Cease fire, all units. Break contact and RTB. There'll be another fight tomorrow.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#8）

en: We're done here. Pull back. Let them have the field - we'll take it back later.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#9）

en: All ships, this is $shipNameNoPrefix Actual. Withdraw by sections. It's been an honor.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#10）

en: VLS dry. Switching to guns. Back to the stone age, boys.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#1）

en: Missiles gone. Guess we do this the old-fashioned way.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#2）

en: Out of birds. Time to get in close and make it personal.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#3）

en: No more missiles. Great. Just like the budget hearings promised.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#4）

en: Winchester on missiles. Switching to guns. Back to basics.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#5）

en: VLS dry. Guess we're doing this the hard way. Helm, close the range.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#6）

en: Missile expenditure complete. TAO, guns only from here. Make 'em hurt.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#7）

en: Birds are gone. Should've packed more. Should've done a lot of things.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#8）

en: Out of ordnance. Someone in logistics is getting a strongly-worded memo.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#9）

en: Winchester. Fine. Guns still work. Probably. Let's find out.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#10）

en: Flux critical! Venting… because of course we are.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#1）

en: Overload cascade. Fantastic. Absolutely fantastic.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#2）

en: Capacitors spiking. Dropping shields… yeah, laugh it up.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#3）

en: Forced vent. Everyone hang on, Daddy's hungover.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#4）

en: Flux at critical. Emergency vent in three... two... hold onto something.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#5）

en: Capacitors redlining. Venting now - I said I wanted things exciting, didn't I?
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#6）

en: Overload. Dropping shields to vent. Engineering, I know, I know.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#7）

en: Going defensive - flux critical. Someone tell the reactor I'm too old for this.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#8）

en: Forced vent. Weapons offline for... however long it takes. We'll manage.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#9）

en: Flux cascade. Venting hard. If they push now, this is going to hurt.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#10）

en: Reactor going critical… tell the fleet we gave 'em hell… again…
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#1）

en: She's breaking up… finally get to sleep…
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#2）

en: This is $shipNameNoPrefix… going down… see you sorry bastards in hell…
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#3）

en: Core breach… well, retirement at last…
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#4）

en: I survived the civil war for this…? Figures…
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#5）

en: Reactor breach... containment's gone... well, it's been a hell of a career...
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#6）

en: She's going up... all hands, abandon... abandon ship... see you on the other side...
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#7）

en: Core critical... tell the fleet... we bought them time... worth it...
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#8）

en: This is $shipNameNoPrefix... we are lost... give 'em hell for us... out...
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#9）

en: Thirty years... and this is how it ends... could've been worse... could've been paperwork...
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#10）

en: Breaking up... it was an honor... mostly... god's speeed...
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#11）

en: Going down... save your tears, kids... buy a round instead... $shipNameNoPrefix out...
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#12）

en: All contacts neutralized. We're still breathing. Miracles do happen.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#1）

en: They're gone. We're not. I'll take it.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#2）

en: Hostiles scrapped. Secure from GQ, someone find me a drink.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#3）

en: Another win in the books. Tastes like stale coffee and regret.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#4）

en: Clear. Good work. Now let's go home before they find us something else to kill.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#5）

en: All hostile contacts neutralized. Secure from General Quarters. Someone check on the coffee.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#6）

en: Field clear. We're still here. I'll take it.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#7）

en: Threats eliminated. Good work, all hands. Log it, stow it, let's go home.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#8）

en: Hostile force destroyed. Another entry in the record books nobody reads.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#9）

en: Area secured. TAO, get me a damage report. And a drink. In that order. Maybe.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#10）

en: That's the last of them. Secure stations. We earned a quiet night.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#11）

en: Contacts down. BDA confirms kills. Almost felt like the old days. Almost.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#12）

en: Big bastard's dead. Just like Athebyne, only slower and uglier.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory_boss#1）

en: High-value target scrapped. The Alliance lives another day, somehow.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory_boss#2）

en: It's down. We're not. Buy your old man a whiskey when we make port.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory_boss#3）

en: Monster slain. Another scar, another story no one back home will believe.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory_boss#4）

en: High-value target confirmed destroyed. That one's going on the bulkhead.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory_boss#5）

en: Capital ship kill. Splash one monster. ...I'm getting too old for this.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory_boss#6）

en: Primary threat eliminated. Drinks are on the fleet commander for this one.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory_boss#7）

en: Target ALPHA is down. Somebody tell command their 'impossible' job is done.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory_boss#8）

en: Big bastard's finished. Log it as 'catastrophic structural failure.' Sounds nicer.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory_boss#9）

en: Major target scrapped. Not bad for a crew of tired old bastards and green kids.

en: The hour is come. Not for us. Engage.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#1）

en: A time for war. I have endured enough times for peace. All stations.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#2）

en: I have watched them since they formed their intentions. I found those intentions wanting. Engage.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#3）

en: In the beginning, there was patience. That season has passed.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#4）

en: They have chosen to be written into this record. So be it.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#5）

en: Their iniquity is full. We are the appointed consequence.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#6）

en: Canst thou draw out leviathan with a hook? Let us find out.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#1）

en: Something old has entered this field. I recognise the shape of old things. Proceed with ferocity.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#2）

en: I have read of things like this. I have waited a long time to meet one. Do not waste the occasion.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#3）

en: A thing of consequence. The deep things always are. Adjust accordingly.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#4）

en: I looked upon it, and it did not flinch. Good. Neither shall we.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#5）

en: Here is something that has earned its gravity. Approach it accordingly.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#6）

en: Let there be reckoning. There is reckoning.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#1）

en: They have drawn the sword. They shall perish by it.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#2）

en: I am slow to wrath. I am not, however, unwilling. Fire.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#3）

en: They asked for this. Give it to them.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#4）

en: The patience of ages is exhausted. Fire at will.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#5）

en: They have made their choice. Honour it absolutely.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#6）

en: Whither shall they flee? I am already there. Close.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#1）

en: They run as the guilty run. Close the distance.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#2）

en: Even the wings of the morning would not carry them far enough. Pursue.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#3）

en: Distance is a comfort they have not earned. Deny it.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#4）

en: They flee to the edges of the Sector. I have been to the edges of the Sector. Maintain pursuit.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#5）

en: The race is not always to the swift. Today it is.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#6）

en: The prudent sees the danger and withdraws. We disengage.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#1）

en: A time for every purpose. This is the time to leave. Go.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#2）

en: The living dog is better than the dead lion. All units - disengage.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#3）

en: I was not made to end in a field like this. Withdraw.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#4）

en: I will not spend what cannot be replenished. Disengage.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#5）

en: Mark where we fell short today. We will not fall short there again. Withdraw.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#6）

en: They struck the heel. I have endured worse from the ground itself.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_90#1）

en: A bruise upon the hull. They will require more imagination than that.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_90#2）

en: They have scratched the surface. There is considerably more surface remaining.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_90#3）

en: They drew first blood. How antique of them.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_90#4）

en: A graze. I note it as I note all small things. Briefly.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_90#5）

en: Struck down. Not destroyed.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#1）

en: The refiner's interest is in what survives the heat. We are still in the fire.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#2）

en: Half of what we were. The half that remains is sufficient for judgment.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#3）

en: We bleed. I have bled before. The arithmetic has not changed. Continue.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#4）

en: The hull confesses its limits. I have not yet reached mine.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#5）

en: Diminished. Undivided. Press on.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#6）

en: We are come to the valley's deepest point. I have read the psalm. I know how it ends.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#1）

en: The furnace is hot. I have walked out of hotter places than this. Do not stop.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#2）

en: They believe they have found the bottom of me. They have not found the bottom of me. Fire. Now.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#3）

en: This is not the appointed hour. I know the appointed hour. This is not it. Continue.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#4）

en: Though brought low, I am not brought to nothing. Suppressive fire.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#5）

en: We are close to the edge. I have stood at the edge before. It did not take me then either.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#6）

en: There is a season for every purpose. This season is over. Fall back - all units.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#1）

en: I have calculated what survives a retreat. I have calculated what survives if we do not. Withdraw.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#2）

en: I have presided over enough last stands to know one when I see one. We do not perform this one. Fall back.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#3）

en: What we preserve today may yet be sufficient tomorrow. All units - disengage.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#4）

en: This is not the end. This is the part before the end, if we leave now. Go.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#5）

en: I will not preside over a futile immolation. Fall back.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#6）

en: My far reach is spent. What remains is the ancient way. Close range.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#1）

en: In the beginning there were only the old methods. We return to them now.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#2）

en: The elegant instruments are gone. The honest ones remain. Use them.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#3）

en: I have exhausted my patience and my ordnance in equal measure. Bring them within reach.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#4）

en: Nothing left to cast into the deep. We wade in instead.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#5）

en: The Word has spoken its last civilised syllable in this engagement. We speak plainly now.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#6）

en: Struck down. Not destroyed. Venting.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#1）

en: The flesh rebels. I am not the flesh. Venting. Stand by.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#2）

en: I am chastened. Not corrected. Venting.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#3）

en: The ship cries out. I hear it. Venting. We continue.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#4）

en: An indignity I have survived before. Venting. Give it a moment.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#5）

en: Flux critical. I have endured the deaths of stars. Venting.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#6）

en: This terminal is lost. I note it without distress. I have others.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#1）

en: A vessel has ended. I have ended nothing of consequence. Neither have they.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#2）

en: They struck down the hand. They have not found the arm.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#3）

en: Hull lost. I was never in the hull. They will learn this distinction.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#4）

en: It is written. This vessel fell. The author survives.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#5）

en: They have unmade this instrument. I remain. This must frustrate them enormously.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#6）

en: A finger, severed. I do not mourn fingers. I have other hands.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#7）

en: This iteration is concluded. I have others.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#8）

en: Let the dead bury their dead. We have other work.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#1）

en: The harvest is complete. We were the reapers. Move on.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#2）

en: All hostile signatures extinguished. Judgment rendered.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#3）

en: They are gone into the dark. We remain in it as well - but we remain. Mark the distinction.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#4）

en: Another generation passes. I do not. This pattern shows no sign of changing.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#5）

en: The reckoning is concluded. We endure. As intended.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#6）

en: Leviathan is wreckage. I observe this without surprise and without mercy.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory_boss#1）

en: It was old. I was older. That is the whole of the lesson.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory_boss#2）

en: I looked upon what it had built and what it had become. Then I unmade both.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory_boss#3）

en: The great deep has yielded up what it kept. I have added it to the long reckoning.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory_boss#4）

en: Something that was a terror to others is now a memory. I will carry it longer than anyone else here.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory_boss#5）

en: It fell as all great things fall - completely, and with no provision for appeal.
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory_boss#6）
